workflow: A component retrieves a cache-like object through an overridable accessor that may create a fresh object.
The accessor returns an owned reference, but the helper mistakenly treats it as borrowed and releases it before returning the pointer.
The newly created object is deallocated while the caller still holds the pointer.
The caller accesses the cache through the dangling pointer, causing a use-after-free and process termination.
summary: Premature release leaves returned cache pointer dangling
